email_subject: Application - Junior App Growth Consultant at AppTweak
email_body:
Dear AppTweak Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Junior App Growth Consultant role. Your focus on ASO and mobile growth aligns with my background in SEO, content, and data-driven optimization. I've built and optimized websites for search, including technical audits and keyword research, and I'm eager to apply that analytical mindset to app stores.

I'm based in Belgium, fluent in English, and excited to learn ASO deeply while helping Enterprise clients grow. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear AppTweak Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Junior App Growth Consultant position. AppTweak's reputation as an ASO leader and its data-driven, human-centered approach resonate with my own background in SEO and digital marketing. I'm eager to bring my analytical skills and curiosity about mobile growth to your team.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and content for client websites, using Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console to track performance. I've also built and optimized websites for search, including technical audits and structured data implementation. This experience has taught me how to translate data into actionable recommendations—a skill directly relevant to ASO audits and keyword optimization.

I have a technical foundation from my computer science coursework and front-end development experience, and I've built an Android app that is live on Google Play. This hands-on exposure to the app ecosystem, combined with my SEO expertise, gives me a solid starting point for understanding app store optimization. I'm comfortable working with complex data in Excel and presenting insights clearly, and I thrive in fast-paced environments where I can learn quickly.

I'm based in Belgium and fluent in English. I'm excited about the opportunity to develop ASO expertise and help Enterprise clients achieve their growth goals. I'd love to discuss how my skills can contribute to AppTweak's continued success.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
• SEO & GEO expertise: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical audits, structured data—directly transferable to ASO audits and keyword optimization.
• Analytical & reporting skills: daily use of Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs; comfortable with complex data and Excel.
• Mobile app experience: built and published an Android app live on Google Play, providing hands-on insight into the app ecosystem.
• Client-facing work: managed SEO content and CMS for multiple client websites, collaborating with teams to deliver results.
• Technical background: front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) and computer science coursework, enabling quick mastery of app store mechanics.
